verdict.rationale: Featurebase markets AI features for decluttering feedback and surfacing impactful opportunities, plus an AI agent (Fibi) for resolving customer issues, which implies some AI-generated insight generation. However, there is no detailed documentation on how these insights/suggestions are surfaced to users, what data they draw from, or independent verification of accuracy/usefulness. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the insight-generation mechanism, examples of AI suggestions in the UI, and independent/hands-on validation of quality.
